title: Enquadramento
prompt: Gera o conteúdo da secção "Contexto da Empresa" na estrutura definido pelo JSON schema no formato markdown-it.

title: Next Steps
prompt: Next Steps: concrete engagement proposal and support plan from Oramix. Markdown-it.

title: Use Case Recommendations
prompt: Use Case Recommendations: 2-3 specific justified use cases prioritized by assessment results, with business value. Relevant to the assessment context. Markdown-it.

title: Roadmap
prompt: Roadmap: structured plan with milestones for 3, 6, and 12 months. Markdown-it.

title: Quick Wins
prompt: Quick Wins: 3-5 specific actionable items for 0-3 months with expected outcome. Markdown-it.

title: Gap Map
prompt: Gap Map: prioritized markdown table with columns: Gap | Impact (H/M/L) | Effort (H/M/L) | Priority (1-5). Markdown-it.

title: Maturity Radar
prompt: Maturity Radar: written interpretation of the radar, identifying patterns and outliers. Markdown-it.

title: Results by Pillar
prompt: Results by Pillar: detailed analysis for each of the pillars with scores and insights from actual answers. Markdown-it.

title: Methodology
prompt: Methodology: pillar descriptions, 1-5 scale explanation, data collection process. Contextualized for the assessment type. Markdown-it.

title: Executive Summary
prompt: Executive Summary: global score, top 3 strengths, top 3 gaps, key recommendation. Specific to the assessment type. Markdown-it.
